speech.text: Know your place.
Those are six months of my life.
Forty coats. My name gets the check. Yours gets swept up.
speech.reason: His last words continue over Alma lowering her eyes.

speech.text: Tell the buyer and you'll never work in this room again.
My mother put her mark inside every coat. So do I.
The theater tour orders forty coats today. Who made this one?
I designed it. She just holds the pins.
He tore off my label. Ask him what's under the left lapel.
speech.reason: Point of the accusation. The cuff and her pointing hand identify the left lapel under her continuing voice. Return to both women as Nina considers the challenge.

speech.text: Your design, Mr. Hale. What's underneath?
Plain silk. Turn it inside out if you like.
speech.reason: Gavin draws breath to answer over the final two frames of Nina waiting beside the upright coat.

speech.text: Pack it up. The fitting's over.
speech.reason: His order continues as the dark cover hides the sample on the form.

speech.text: Fire me, then. The coat stays.
A gold crane. Under the left lapel. Open it yourself.
A gold crane. Right where you said.
She sews for me. That bird belongs to me too.
Last winter he sold twelve of mine. I never saw a cent.
speech.reason: Nina takes in the accusation as Alma finishes off camera.

speech.text: Sign with me. Ten percent stays in your pocket.
Say it louder. I want the woman you stole from to hear.
You walk out now!
You're off the tour, Gavin. Leave your badge on the table.
Forty coats. Your name on every one.
speech.reason: Nina begins the award over the surrendered credential

speech.text: Know your place.

actions.action: Gavin strikes the drawings out of her hands. Alma raises her gaze and holds his.
Alma pulls the drawing loose from under his polished shoe.
Alma retrieves the scattered sketches and confronts him. He closes his arms defensively.
Gavin claims the commission.
Gavin peels the light rectangle off the lapel, holds it up, and reveals an uninterrupted patch of blue exactly where it was.
Gavin brandishes the scrap and closes his fist. Alma draws her hands up and drops her gaze.
From raised hands Alma steadies her breath and points at the hidden maker mark.
The manager clips his black mark onto the bare lapel.
Nina sets down the folder and turns to inspect the blue sample.
Gavin points from himself to the coat while Nina listens, then turns her gaze.
Alma directs Nina's attention to the underside of the lapel.
Nina questions him without taking the garment off the form.
Gavin dares Nina to inspect the lining.
Gavin throws a black garment cover over the blue coat; the next continuous shot T14 opens with the same cover on it.
Alma pulls the black garment bag off the mannequin, baring the blue jacket again.
Alma indicates the lapel but leaves the actual test for Nina.
Nina parts the blue lapel; a large gold crane on pale lining becomes fully visible.
Nina looks from the opened coat to its maker and gives an affirmative smile.
Gavin points at the seamstress; she meets his accusation with her chin held high.
The maker leans on the bench and meets the commissioner's eyes before they both look down.
Gavin leans in and slides his hand onto the contract while the buyer listens.
The envelope travels to Nina, pauses, then returns from her side of the table to his.
Nina challenges the bribe directly and turns to include the victim.
Gavin moves across the doorway to issue the last threat. Alma holds her ground.
Nina gestures at the bench. Gavin lowers his head in public.
Gavin puts the backstage credential on the wood beside the contract, withdraws his empty fingers and leaves Alma beside both objects.
Nina transfers the navy contract folder from her hands into Alma's.
Alma holds the commission to her chest and delivers the original insult back to Gavin.
Alma turns back to the blue coat and smooths its shoulder.
